SystemName.description:
The six agent systems, plus the Phase 0 scaffolding placeholders.

Using an enum (rather than free text) means a typo in a target system name
fails at the sender instead of silently routing nowhere.
SystemName.title: SystemName

description: The envelope every A2A task between systems carries.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope contract, so receivers can reject unknown shapes.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

incident_id.description: Stable id for the incident this message is about; the join key into the incident store.
incident_id.title: Incident Id

timestamp.description: UTC time the message was created by the sending system.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

target_system.description: System this message is addressed to.

payload.description: System-specific body. Shape grows per system in later phases.
payload.title: Payload

correlation_id.description: Id of the message being replied to, for request/response pairing.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id
